hook.en: The temperature through a day changes smoothly: no sudden jumps. A taxi fare jumps at each kilometre. Mathematics calls the first kind of change continuous.

objectives.en: Define continuity at a point using limits
Know which standard functions are continuous

narration.en: The temperature through a day changes smoothly: no sudden jumps. A taxi fare jumps at each kilometre. Mathematics calls the first kind of change continuous.
narration.kn: ದಿನವಿಡೀ ತಾಪಮಾನ ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ: ಹಠಾತ್ ಜಿಗಿತಗಳಿಲ್ಲ. ಟ್ಯಾಕ್ಸಿ ದರ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಿಲೋಮೀಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಜಿಗಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೊದಲ ಬಗೆಯ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯನ್ನು ಗಣಿತ ಸಂತತ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: $f$ is continuous at $x = c$ if $\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = f(c)$, i.e. the left-hand limit, the right-hand limit and the value $f(c)$ all exist and are equal. $f$ is continuous if it is continuous at every point of its domain.
body.kn: lim_{x→c} f(x) = f(c) ಆದರೆ f, x = c ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತತ. ಅಂದರೆ ಎಡ ಮಿತಿ, ಬಲ ಮಿತಿ ಮತ್ತು f(c) ಮೂರೂ ಸಮ.

points.en: A jump or a hole means discontinuity

narration.en: A function is continuous at c if the left-hand limit, the right-hand limit and the value at c are all equal.
narration.kn: lim_{x→c} f(x) = f(c) ಆದರೆ f, x = c ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತತ. ಅಂದರೆ ಎಡ ಮಿತಿ, ಬಲ ಮಿತಿ ಮತ್ತು f(c) ಮೂರೂ ಸಮ.

body.en: Polynomials, $\sin x$, $\cos x$, $e^x$, $|x|$ are continuous everywhere; $\log x$ for $x > 0$; rational functions wherever the denominator is non-zero. Sums, differences, products and quotients (denominator $\ne 0$) of continuous functions are continuous, and so is a composition of continuous functions.
body.kn: ಬಹುಪದಗಳು, sin x, cos x, eˣ, |x| ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಸಂತತ. ಸಂತತ ಫಲನಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ, ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ, ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ, ಭಾಗಲಬ್ಧ (ಛೇದ ≠ 0) ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ ಸಂತತ.

narration.en: Polynomials, sine, cosine, exponential and modulus are continuous everywhere. Adding, multiplying, dividing where allowed, or composing continuous functions keeps them continuous.
